title: Bijectivity of finite coordinate combinations of affine basis germs
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], x in an affine open U and let H and c_n be the explicit maps of [def-sc-affine-free-basis-germs]. For every natural number n the linear map c_n : ULift(Fin(n) -> O_{X,x}) -> H(ULift(Fin(n) -> Gamma(X,U))) is bijective.

source.place: Tag 01HV, Lemma 26.5.4 (7), natural associated-sheaf stalk localization; Tag 01IB, affine module sheafification; Tag 01C6, finite free sheaves; Tag 0098, restriction along the affine chart; direct-image stalk computed on the cofinal neighbourhoods contained in U

proof.text: The coordinate inclusions and projections have pi_p i_q equal to the identity when p=q and zero otherwise, and their opposite composites sum to the identity. Additivity carries these identities through H, so the H(pi_p) are jointly injective and H(pi_p)c_n(v) = c(v_p).

Injectivity of c implies injectivity of c_n by applying each H(pi_p). For a target element choose preimages under c of each of its projected coordinates; the resulting tuple maps to it because its projected coordinates agree. The reconstruction identity handles n=0 as well.
